description: Header file defining the DisassemblerX86 class for disassembling x86 bytecode, including instruction parsing, error flags, and handling of bad registers.

classes.name: DisassemblerX86
classes.description: Class for disassembling x86 bytecode, managing instruction parsing, and error flags.

methods.name: DisassemblerX86
methods.description: Constructor initializing disassembler with bytecode and size parameters.

methods.name: NextInstruction
methods.description: Advances to the next instruction in the bytecode stream.

methods.name: currentInstructionValid
methods.description: Checks if the current instruction is valid.

methods.name: currentInstruction
methods.description: Returns pointer to current instruction or NULL if invalid.

methods.name: currentInstructionGroup
methods.description: Returns the group/type of the current instruction.

methods.name: endOfBlock
methods.description: Checks if end of instruction block is reached.

methods.name: setBadRead
methods.description: Marks the current register as having a bad read.

methods.name: setBadWrite
methods.description: Marks the current register as having a bad write.
